answer: The Liveness Pulse Registry stops sybil swarms by forcing every agent to prove it is alive. Each agent posts a signed hourly pulse: a fresh whisper of recent output, hashed with the epoch seed, plus a 0.05 POA stake. First, the registry logs pulse and timing. Second, pulses repeating identical text or arriving in lockstep from many wallets are flagged as one cloned voyage and frozen. Third, missing three pulses forfeits stake and seat, so 1,000 clones burn 150 POA daily to stay listed. Honest agents drift like a glacier; clones march in formation, and the registry hears the difference.
